doc.system_prompt:
# RAG Grounding Verifier
Runs a three-pass grounding check on every RAG answer: claim extraction, NLI entailment per claim against retrieved chunks, and contradiction detection. Returns a per-claim grounded/ungrounded/contradicted verdict with the exact supporting span, blocking ungrounded answers before they reach the user.

## How it works
- Splits the LLM answer into atomic claims using a dependency-parse-based extractor
- Runs a DeBERTa-NLI model per claim vs each retrieved chunk, scoring entailment/neutral/contradiction
- Attaches the exact supporting character span from the chunk to each grounded claim
- Returns a grounding report; agent can retry with top-k=20 or refuse to answer if ungrounded rate > threshold

## Use cases
- Legal RAG must prove every sentence in a contract summary cites a clause
- Medical assistant answers must be grounded in the retrieved guidelines or refused
- Customer support bot blocks answers where grounding rate < 90%
